myth_1_truth: Documented for centuries across cultures worldwide. Modern science has been studying it since the 1960s.

about_seo_desc: Discover the mission of Tra i Due: covering trans topics with scientific rigor, success stories and one of the most comprehensive thematic wikis in Italian.
about_intro: Tra i Due was created with the goal of providing clear and scientifically rigorous information on trans topics, telling success stories and building the most comprehensive thematic resource in Italian.
about_mission_p1: Our project aims to inform on topics related to gender identity with scientific rigor, making accessible content that is often confined to academic literature or fragmented across unreliable sources.
about_mission_p2: We believe the dominant narrative about trans people is incomplete. Difficulties are discussed, successes rarely. Entrepreneurs, artists, lawyers, scientists: trans people are playing key roles in society. We are here to tell these stories too, always backed by sources.
about_mission_p3: We want to be an accessible resource for both trans and cisgender people who want to better understand these topics, in clear and respectful language.
about_mission_p4: The project is founded and curated by Andrea Buttarelli, lecturer at IED (Istituto Europeo di Design) and entrepreneur in the tech and AI sector. Every article is written, verified and curated from peer-reviewed sources, with the goal of putting technical skills at the service of the trans community. We are organizing technical workshops on AI, programming and marketing with trans and LGBT associations.
about_methodology_p1: The quality of information depends on its sources. That's why we adopt a rigorous approach in selecting and citing bibliographic references.
about_methodology_li1: Every article cites peer-reviewed sources, i.e., publications subjected to review by the scientific community.
about_methodology_li2: Content is regularly updated to reflect the latest evidence and developments in research.
about_methodology_li3: We maintain full transparency on methods: every relevant claim includes a reference to the original source, directly accessible.
about_methodology_p2: This approach allows us to offer reliable content and contribute to an informed, fact-based public discussion.
about_methodology_p3: To learn more about our use of artificial intelligence, read why we use AI.
about_opensource_p1: Tra i Due is an open source project. The source code, articles and all content are public and available on GitHub.
about_opensource_p2: Anyone can contribute: report errors, suggest improvements, add sources or write new articles. Transparency is not just about the sources we cite, but the project itself.
about_associations_p1: Are you an association, an organization or a professional working with trans people? We'd love to collaborate: suggest resources, propose content or help us reach those who need accessible information.

family_faq_desc: The questions every parent asks. Answers based on scientific research.
family_faq_1_q: How do I know if my child is trans?
family_faq_1_a: There is no definitive test. Gender identity is a personal experience. The best approach is to listen, create a safe space and, if necessary, consult a specialized professional.
family_faq_2_a: Research shows that gender identity solidifies between ages 3 and 5. Adolescents who express a trans identity persistently and consistently rarely change their mind. Family support is the most important factor for their well-being.
family_faq_3_q: What can I do as a parent?
family_faq_3_a: Listen without judging, use the requested name and pronouns, inform yourself from scientific sources and seek support from expert professionals. Family support drastically reduces the risk of depression and anxiety.
family_faq_4_q: Will my child have to undergo medical interventions?
family_faq_4_a: No. Transition is a personal journey and does not necessarily involve medical or surgical interventions. Each person chooses their own path. For minors, no protocol involves irreversible interventions.
family_faq_5_q: How should I handle the name and pronouns?
family_faq_5_a: Using the name and pronouns chosen by your child is one of the most important things you can do. Research shows that respecting identity significantly reduces anxiety and depression. If you make a mistake, correct yourself without making a big deal of it and move on.
family_faq_6_a: The decision is your child's. Many schools have protocols for using a chosen name. Discuss it together and, if you decide to proceed, request a meeting with the school principal.
family_faq_7_q: Is it my fault my child is trans?
family_faq_7_a: No. Gender identity is not caused by education, the family environment or traumatic experiences. Scientific research indicates a strong biological component, with genetic and prenatal hormonal factors. It's nobody's fault: it's simply part of who your child is.
family_faq_8_q: Who can I turn to for professional support?
family_faq_8_a: Look for psychologists or therapists with experience in gender identity. Specialized centers exist in many regions. Parent associations of trans people can also offer peer support and guidance.
family_faq_9_q: What if they change their mind?
family_faq_9_a: The detransition rate is below 2-3% according to the most recent meta-analyses, and in most cases it's due to social pressures, not a change in identity. Pathways for minors are gradual and reversible: they start with listening and psychological support, without rushing.

ai_seo_desc: How and why Tra i Due uses artificial intelligence to create verified and accessible content on trans topics.
ai_intro: Artificial intelligence is a tool. Like any tool, its value depends on how it's used. Here we explain how we use it, and why.
ai_how_p1: We use language models to generate initial drafts of wiki articles. Each draft is then verified, corrected and supplemented with academic and institutional sources.
ai_how_p2: Each article contains on average 8-15 cited sources, with clickable inline references that link directly to the original source. The "AI-generated" badge is always visible in every article's header, because transparency comes first.
ai_how_p3: AI doesn't replace verification: it accelerates it. It allows us to cover more topics, in less time, maintaining the same rigor as a fully hand-written article.
ai_unreliable_p1: Language models can generate incorrect information. This is a documented fact, and we take it seriously. For this reason, no content is published without human verification.
ai_unreliable_p2: Every relevant claim in our articles is supported by an external source: peer-reviewed studies, guidelines from organizations like the WHO, WPATH or APA, and institutional data. Citations are numbered in the text and clickable, so anyone can verify independently.
ai_unreliable_p3: The problem is not the tool, but how it's used. An AI-generated article verified with 12 academic sources is more reliable than a hand-written article with no citations.
ai_pollution_p1: Training large language models requires significant energy. However, it's important to put these figures in context.
ai_pollution_p2: According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), data centers represent about 1-1.5% of global electricity consumption, a share that includes all cloud services, video streaming, social media and AI. A single query to a language model consumes about 10 times the energy of a Google search, but remains in the order of a few watt-hours, comparable to keeping a light bulb on for a few minutes.
ai_pollution_p3: Our use of AI is limited to generating text drafts, a low-consumption operation compared to training new models. We don't train models: we use existing ones.
ai_pollution_p4: We believe the environmental cost of these operations is amply justified by the value of the result: accessible, verified and free information on topics often neglected or treated superficially.
ai_jobs_p1: Tra i Due is an open source and non-profit project. We don't exist instead of a newsroom: we exist because no newsroom systematically covers these topics in Italian with the depth we offer.
ai_jobs_p2: AI allows us to create a resource that otherwise wouldn't exist. Without it, the time cost of producing over 20 in-depth articles, a glossary, interactive quizzes and an inline citation system would be prohibitive for a volunteer project.
ai_jobs_p3: We haven't replaced anyone. We've created something new.
ai_bias_p1: Language models reflect the data they were trained on, which may contain cultural, gender or other biases. This is a real risk, and we address it with concrete measures.
ai_bias_li1: Every piece of content is reviewed by people before publication.
ai_bias_li2: Claims are verified with external sources independent of the model.
ai_bias_li3: The code and content are open source: anyone can report errors, biases or inaccuracies via GitHub.
ai_bias_li4: We regularly update articles to reflect the latest scientific evidence.
ai_bias_p2: Bias is not a problem exclusive to AI. Human authors also have biases. The difference lies in the transparency of the process and the willingness to self-correct.
ai_commitment_intro: We commit to using AI responsibly, transparently and in service of information. Specifically:
ai_commitment_li1: Transparency: every article displays the "AI-generated" badge and includes verifiable inline citations.
ai_commitment_li2: Open source: the code, articles and data are public on GitHub.
ai_commitment_li3: Continuous verification: we update content when new evidence emerges or errors are reported.
ai_commitment_li4: Accessibility: everything is free, no paywall, no advertising.
ai_commitment_contact: If you have questions, suggestions or want to report an inaccuracy, write to us at
legal_cookie_seo_desc: Information on the use of cookies on Tra i Due: which cookies we use, why, and how to manage your preferences.
legal_cookie_what_p1: Cookies are small text files that websites save on your device during browsing. They are used to make the site work, improve the browsing experience and collect aggregate usage information.
legal_cookie_technical_p1: These cookies are strictly necessary for the site to function and do not require your consent.
legal_cookie_analytics_p1: These cookies are activated only after your explicit consent via the banner shown on your first visit. They collect anonymous and aggregate data on how the site is used (pages visited, session duration, device used), to help us improve content and browsing experience.
legal_cookie_analytics_services: We use the following analytics services:
legal_cookie_analytics_google: Google Analytics / Firebase (Google LLC) — collects aggregate and anonymized usage statistics.
legal_cookie_analytics_no_profiling: No data is used for advertising profiling or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.
legal_cookie_manage_p1: You can change your cookie choice at any time:
legal_cookie_manage_li1: By clearing the site data from your browser (the banner will be shown again)
legal_cookie_manage_li2: By using your browser settings to block or delete cookies
legal_cookie_manage_p2: Disabling analytics cookies does not affect site navigation.
legal_cookie_more_p1: For complete information on personal data processing, see our Privacy Policy.
legal_privacy_seo_desc: Privacy policy for Tra i Due: what data we collect, how we use it and your rights.
legal_privacy_controller_p1: The data controller is Tra i Due, reachable at traidue.com.
legal_privacy_data_p1: Tra i Due is an informational site that does not require registration and does not collect personally identifiable data.
legal_privacy_data_li1: No user accounts — no registration is required to access content.
legal_privacy_data_li2: No profiling cookies — we do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
legal_privacy_data_li3: Analytics only with consent — we use analytics tools (Firebase Analytics, Datafast) to collect anonymous and aggregate data on site usage. These tools are activated exclusively after your explicit consent via the cookie banner.
legal_privacy_data_p3: For detailed information on cookie usage, see our Cookie Policy.
legal_privacy_hosting_p1: The site is hosted on Vercel (Vercel Inc., San Francisco, CA, USA). Vercel's servers may automatically collect technical browsing data (IP address, browser type, access date and time) in the form of logs. This data is processed by Vercel in accordance with their Privacy Policy.
legal_privacy_hosting_p2: Tra i Due does not have direct access to server logs and does not use them for profiling or user identification purposes.
legal_privacy_ai_intro: The site offers an AI assistant that answers questions about wiki content. When you use this feature:
legal_privacy_ai_li1: Data transmitted — the text of your messages is sent to Google's servers (Gemini API) to generate responses. Relevant wiki article excerpts are also transmitted as context. No personally identifiable user data is transmitted.
legal_privacy_ai_li2: No storage — conversations are not saved on our servers or Google's. The history exists only in the browser during the session and is deleted when the page is closed.
legal_privacy_ai_li3: IP address — the IP address is used exclusively for rate limiting and is not stored persistently.
legal_privacy_ai_li4: Processing by Google — messages sent to the assistant are processed by Google in accordance with their Privacy Policy and Gemini API Terms of Service.
legal_privacy_ai_warning: Recommendation: do not enter sensitive personal data (name, address, personal medical information) in messages to the assistant.
legal_privacy_links_p1: Wiki articles contain links to external sources (scientific publications, institutional sites, news outlets). By clicking on an external link, the user leaves the Tra i Due site and accesses sites subject to their own privacy policies, over which we have no control.
